description: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet to csv or xlsx into blob storage and return its sheet_blob_key. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet through Drive into platform blob storage as CSV for the default tab or XLSX for the complete multi-tab workbook. Returns a sheet blob key for email attachments or downstream plugins. Use this when a Google-native spreadsheet must become a portable file.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with sheet_blob_key (a blob-storage reference to the exported bytes).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export and format used. The sheet_blob_key references potentially sensitive corporate content — surface it for downstream use but do not treat it as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or format is not csv/xlsx. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass format as csv or xlsx. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
